clue.text: Tedious type leading a university course with a taste of Asia

clue.text: Penelope's left virtually superior valet at last — eg, Parker

explanation.definitionFit: Parker in Thunderbirds was a string marionette, one example of a puppet.

clue.text: This indigene near Colorado's capital could be smart
